mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4% over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% signals improving manufacturing activity and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 12-month MA + 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5% over three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the civilian labor force participation rate (UNRATE) above 62.5% over three consecutive months signals broader labor supply expansion, which increases aggregate income and supports higher consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 62.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average by more than 3% signals strengthening aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when RSAFS > 12-month MA + 3% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).
